title: Military officers who reported UFOs were sent to John Mack for psychiatric exams, and he began investigating

tellings.quote: you know that he and a number of other high ranking military people had been sent to John Mack at Harvard as the head of the department of clinical psychiatry

plain: Some time in the 1980s or 1990s, high-ranking military officers who had reported UFOs were sent for psychiatric exams to John Mack, head of clinical psychiatry at Harvard, and that, the story goes, is how Mack began looking into the subject himself. A guest named Dan Sheehan tells Michels this, passing on what he was told about one such man and "a number of other high ranking military people" sent to Mack. If true, it would mean the military was quietly sending its own UFO witnesses to a psychiatrist.
